skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced quantitative analysis techniques in microeconomic contexts.
Convert theoretical models into appropriate econometric models.
Apply Ordinary Least Squares regression techniques on various datasets.
Construct and interpret econometric models with binary dependent variables.
Analyze panel data using appropriate econometric methods.
Measure productivity and efficiency using econometric techniques.
Clean and preprocess data for econometric analysis.
Use Stata software for econometric analysis.
Read and synthesize scientific information from multiple sources.
Work effectively in groups to solve assigned problems.
Develop self-learning abilities to enhance knowledge on economic growth issues.
Actively participate in class discussions and presentations.
